known_risks: Workspace filesystem execution is Windows-only and fails closed on other platforms.
Handle-bound directory enumeration is bounded but is not an atomic snapshot; every later operation resolves and inspects its own path again.
Cancellation or process failure during an existing-file in-place write can leave partial content; failed new-file writes use best-effort handle-based cleanup.
Operating-system ACL changes or filesystem mutation by a more privileged process remain outside the application authorization boundary.

TASK-011 (ToolWorker) R1 accepted: unified execution path (Coordinator + Client only), true process-per-request, Windows Job Object with KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE + memory limits, identity boundary (null user rejected), input validation enforcement, response correlation, deterministic tests, no rawInputJson leak, no ex.Message leak, no empty audit catch.
